notes: Yuri authorised uninterrupted dependency-satisfied development under the accepted check-in lineage.
This operation freezes a provider-free repository-static architecture and opens only a later disposable authored-synthetic role-attestation rehearsal.
No ordinary practice, secret value, existing database, product behavior, provider, production runtime, deployment, Pages or protected-ref authority opens.

decisions.summary: Freeze one closed default-off manifest shape, exact restricted logical role and exactly three ordered opaque reference-only secret/key slots.
Treat rotation as fresh immutable independently verified evidence and permit break glass only to deny authority.
Assert no operational environment, role, secret reference or admission evidence; prove the role and tenant isolation only in a later disposable rehearsal.

claim_scope: The canonical population remains zero manifests, practices, runtime roles, secret references and operational-evidence artifacts.
The exact logical role and three opaque reference-only slots are frozen without creating or accessing a database role or secret.
Rotation requires independently verified immutable evidence bound to a full 40-character Git object, and break glass can only deny.
The bounded evaluator can return an evidence-gate reading only; it cannot admit, mount, configure, resolve a secret, connect a database or execute a command.
unresolved_gates: The exact ordinary runtime role and cross-tenant denial still require provider-free disposable PostgreSQL attestation.
Atomic rollback and unknown-commit recovery remain a later operational-evidence gate.
Ordinary-practice activation, occupied DeepSeek HMR, live secrets, product runtime, deployment, Pages and protected integration remain closed.

current_position.outcome: The next tranche is a provider-free uniquely named disposable PostgreSQL attestation with ephemeral authored-synthetic identifiers and exact cleanup.
unlocks: Representative non-owner and NOBYPASSRLS role evidence for the ordinary check-in environment gate.
Exact cross-tenant denial evidence under the same frozen manifest vocabulary.
A later rollback and unknown-commit rehearsal against the same environment boundary.
does_not_solve: No real secret, existing database, product data or persistent database role is used.
No ordinary-practice check-in command is enabled or mounted.
No provider, production runtime, deployment, release, Pages or protected integration opens.
